independent_reference.source: Exact mass conservation by the reintegration-tracking construction: each cell redistributes its FULL mass to flow-displaced neighbours via bilinear weights that sum to 1, so Sigma A_{t+dt} == Sigma A_t. Conserved to floating-point SUMMATION roundoff (~N*eps) — NOT bit-exact (the weights sum to 1 algebraically; their float sum carries roundoff). Source: Plantec et al., Flow-Lenia, ALIFE 2022 (arXiv:2212.07906); the reintegration mass balance Sum_p I(p',p)=1. Hand-derived.

Non-negativity: the forward bilinear splat redistributes NON-NEGATIVE mass with NON-NEGATIVE weights (1-wi)(1-wj),...,wi*wj (each in [0,1]) -> the output mass field is >= 0 everywhere. A distinct invariant (range, not sum) and method (sign analysis of the splat weights). Hand-derived; arXiv:2212.07906.

Zero-flow identity: with F == 0 the target (i+dt*0, j+dt*0)=(i,j) and the bilinear weights collapse to (1,0,0,0), so each cell maps to itself with weight 1 -> the mass field is UNCHANGED pointwise (EXACT). The advection-by-zero-velocity degenerate case; distinct from A1/A2 in being a pointwise identity. Hand-derived.
